system.description:
The seafaring school of Opal's docks and merchant fleets: fast, pragmatic, built for the chaos of a boarding action, and more concerned with winning than with style. Free crews such as Moon's Free Company learn it too.

  • Reshapes: Parry and Riposte.
  • Deckhand's Escape: after you Parry or Riposte, you may move up to 10ft, ignoring difficult terrain.
    • 9th level: this move and Acrobatic Escape's can climb or swing on rigging, ropes and chandeliers without a check.
  • Dockside Rapport: Advantage on Seamanship checks and on Charisma checks with sailors, dock workers and maritime merchants.
